subject: [PATCH v2 1/4] kernfs: don't repeat or skip an entry when readdir resumes

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the kernfs readdir implementation where it can repeat or skip an entry when resuming a directory listing. The issue occurs because the kernel keeps track of its position using a name hash, but if the entry at that hash is removed, the search for the next entry stops prematurely. The patch restores the original behavior of searching for the first entry at or after the hash and only steps forward when the pinned entry is still present.
